_note: Demo client with made-up details. Copy this file for each new business and change every value.

summary.targets: booking rate 40% or better, show rate 90% or better, cost per lead under $40
levers: Google and Meta ad budgets and which campaigns run
how fast front desk replies to new enquiries
reminder texts the day before appointments
practitioner rostering and which hours are open for new patients
follow-up calls for people who enquired but didn't book
quirks: Cost per booking is blended: it divides all ad spend by all bookings, including bookings that didn't come from ads.
Platform conversions are Google's and Meta's own counts, for reference only. Leads come from the CRM.
Xero payments can lag 1-2 days behind the invoice.

metrics.label: New enquiries
metrics.definition: New contacts created that day (Brisbane time), not tagged staff, spam, team-internal or existing-client.

metrics.label: Enquiries from ads
metrics.definition: New enquiries whose source or tags map to Google Ads or Meta.

metrics.label: Bookings made
metrics.definition: Appointments created that day on the New patient assessment and Pilates intro class calendars, any status except invalid.

metrics.label: Appointments due
metrics.definition: Appointments scheduled for that day on those calendars, not cancelled.

metrics.label: Showed up
metrics.definition: Appointments scheduled for that day with status showed.

metrics.label: Booking rate
metrics.definition: Bookings made divided by new enquiries, from the totals for the period.

metrics.label: Show rate
metrics.definition: Showed up divided by appointments due, from the totals for the period.

metrics.label: Ad spend
metrics.definition: Google Ads plus Meta spend that day as the platforms report it, ex GST, in AUD.

metrics.label: Cost per lead
metrics.definition: Ad spend divided by enquiries from ads.

metrics.label: Cost per booking (blended)
metrics.definition: All ad spend divided by all bookings made, including bookings that didn't come from ads.

metrics.label: Treatment plans won ($)
metrics.definition: Total value of New patients pipeline opportunities marked Won that day.

metrics.label: Revenue invoiced
metrics.definition: Sales invoices dated that day, ex GST, excluding draft and voided.

metrics.label: Cash received
metrics.definition: Payments received on sales invoices that day, inc GST.
